# BlogPost

## Summary

A single article. The isolated view is the reading surface AND the editor: headline, subtitle, cover image, body, categories, and byline are all inline-editable (double-click via EditableField) — no edit-mode switch needed. A drawer carries publish/unpublish and a per-post theme picker; reading progress renders as a top bar. `wordCount`/`readMinutes` are computed from the markdown body; `status` derives from `published`. Fitted templates cover all four tiers.

## Import

```js
import { BlogPost } from '../blog-post';
```

## Usage

Key fields: `headline`, `body` (rich markdown), `featuredImage`, `authors` (linksToMany Author), `categories` (linksToMany BlogCategory), `published`, `publishDate`.
